verdict.rationale: Cline exposes its agent through ACP, so any ACP-capable client can drive it programmatically, and the docs mention building agents and integrations on the same core engine. Its hosted api.cline.bot Chat Completions endpoint is a model gateway rather than a way to drive the agent, and it publishes no machine-readable spec of its own (openapi paths return 401/404). Missing for 10: a dedicated documented public REST/SDK API reference for driving agent tasks, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Any ACP-capable client can use Cline as its coding agent without a dedicated extension
Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
